protective_stop.status: frozen 2026-10-19 (user decision): every method, in simulation, as the real CRX contact stop; a joint more than tracking_error_rad from the target it was commanded to for periods control periods in a row, or faster than speed_factor x its maximum speed, ends the trial as protective_stop (a failure). Normal pick-and-place on Isaac lagged 0.32 mrad at most (DexAgent orange delivery incl. set-down; ASPIRE reference 0.18; free 1.2 rad/s ramp 0.07); a held fragment jammed on the anchor reached 279 mrad and 4.9 rad/s (10 mrad x 3 periods fires 0.3 s after contact)

baselines.assembly_plan_status: decided 2026-10-20 (user): the task's assembly plan (the order the fragments go in and the direction of each one's last straight move, from the layout's ownership_repair plan) is ground truth and every method is given it; the order constraint comes from the 8 mm voxel geometry, not from the real skull. A track that withholds the plan and offers checking tools instead is a later, optional ablation
baselines.collider_inset_status: decided 2026-10-20 (user), changed 2026-10-21 (user): every fragment's collision geometry is 0.25 mm smaller on each face than its voxel cells, so each seam between neighbours is open by 0.5 mm. With the seams closed (0 mm) the scripted reference (sim/assemble.py) brought each fragment to the start of its insertion within 0.1 mm and the insertion still jammed (orange turned 35 deg, blue stopped one voxel high); with 1 mm seams (0.5 mm a face, 2026-10-20) the same insertions ended 0.1 mm off, but a fragment resting on fragments sank 1 mm a layer, and cyan, on blue and on red, tipped 3.8 deg by itself once in place (Isaac, every prefix of the plan put at its goals and settled), into the path of the next insertion. With 0.5 mm seams the worst of every prefix is 0.96 mm / 1.9 deg; insetting only the sideways faces kept them at 0.03 deg but jammed a sideways insertion (cyan turned 21 deg). The meshes shown, the cells, the goals and the assembly plan are unchanged; the printed fragments have clearance too
